next_meeting.note: Albania's hosting agreed at the 2025 Hague summit; dates not announced. Some July 2026 reports questioned whether it would go ahead in Albania.

title.en: Ankara summit: spending and Ukraine aid
title.zh: 安卡拉峰會：國防支出與援烏

summary.en: At the 7-8 July 2026 Ankara summit, allies cited over US$50 billion in new procurement and pledged EUR 70 billion for Ukraine; only five allies are projected to meet the 3.5% core defence target in 2026.
summary.zh: 2026年7月7至8日安卡拉峰會上，盟國宣布逾500億美元新採購並承諾700億歐元援烏；預估2026年僅五國達到3.5%核心國防支出目標。

question.en: How might higher defence spending affect government budgets and other public services?
question.zh: 提高國防支出會如何影響政府預算與其他公共服務？

title.zh: 格陵蘭與北極緊張情勢

summary.en: At the Ankara summit the US president renewed his claim that the US should control Greenland; Denmark said it is not for sale.
summary.zh: 在安卡拉峰會上，美國總統再度主張美國應控制格陵蘭；丹麥表示格陵蘭不賣。

question.en: Why is the Arctic becoming more important for trade routes and resources?
question.zh: 為什麼北極在航運路線與資源上變得越來越重要？

text.zh: 12個創始國簽署《北大西洋公約》

text.zh: 海牙峰會同意2035年國防支出達GDP 5%
